title: Which Cartoon Network show would you live in
dek: No theme songs to name. Twelve questions about the kind of cartoon logic your 2000s childhood actually ran on.

options.label: Bright pink city, everything glossier than it should be
A treehouse with too many antennas
A candy-coloured wasteland with a rainbow over it
A city at dusk, moody and lit like an anime
A villain has taken over the school
One of the imaginary friends has gone missing
Something came out of the dumpster and it talks
A new alien won't stop following you home
A mission with a ridiculous gadget
A fight that turns into a feelings conversation
A quiet suburban street
A lab bench and a lamp
A forest path

options.label: A starry sky

questions.helper: Across: ordinary life or secret organisation. Up: our world or another dimension.
First place is what every good episode opens with.

questions.prompt: I take things personally, dramatically, in front of everyone.
Kindness fixes more than firepower does.
A boring job can turn into an epic if you commit to it.

options.label: The mayor calling to say thank you
Everyone back at the house, slightly changed
A weird creature wandering off into the woods
The watch timing out and everything normal again
The tiny one with the highest voice and the most violence
The imaginary friend nobody else can see
The sidekick with the good hair and the bad plan
The one who works the register and knows everything

results.name: THE POWERPUFF GIRLS
results.blurb: Your life runs on sugar, a strict bedtime and an unreasonable amount of property damage. Somebody calls, you go, the monster is dealt with in eleven minutes and there is homework afterwards. You are small, extremely capable and a little bit terrifying about it.
strengths: Handles a crisis before breakfast
Fiercely protective of the small stuff
Never needs a committee to act
results.watchOut: Not every problem is a monster. Ask before you punch through it.

results.name: FOSTER'S HOME FOR IMAGINARY FRIENDS
results.tagline: The house is full and there's room for one more
results.blurb: Your world is a big, strange house where everyone is welcome and nobody is quite the shape you'd expect. You make room, you explain the rules kindly, and you get attached to people nobody else can see. The chaos is the point, and it is warm.
strengths: Makes space for the odd ones out
Kind without being a pushover
Finds the friend nobody else noticed
results.watchOut: You can't adopt every stray. Keep something for yourself.

results.name: CODENAME: KIDS NEXT DOOR
results.blurb: Your life has a treehouse, a codename and a filing system for missions that definitely should not involve a ten-year-old. You are extremely organised, faintly paranoid about adults, and the best gadget in the room was built out of a toaster and a dream.
strengths: Plans three exits before entering
Comfortable giving orders
Builds the gadget out of nothing
results.watchOut: Not every situation needs a codename and a briefing. Loosen up.

results.name: TEEN TITANS
results.tagline: Fights crime, then talks about feelings
results.blurb: Your week alternates between rooftop battles and one very long, very honest conversation about loyalty. You feel everything at full volume and the sky goes dark when you do. Everybody is a little dramatic, and everybody is a little bit right.
strengths: Fiercely loyal to the team
Takes the emotional stakes seriously
Committed, publicly
results.watchOut: Not every argument is a season finale. Let some things be small.

results.name: BEN 10
results.tagline: The watch is not a toy
results.blurb: Your life is a road trip that keeps getting interrupted by aliens, and the only thing standing between the world and a very bad afternoon is something on your wrist with a cooldown timer. You press it when nobody asked, and it mostly works out.
strengths: Adapts to a brand-new situation fast
Keeps going when the plan breaks
Handles weird calmly
results.watchOut: The good option isn't always the newest one. Consider first.

results.name: ADVENTURE TIME
results.blurb: Your month is a series of small quests across a landscape where nothing makes sense and everything is lovely anyway. There is a song, there is a dungeon, there is a creature with one very specific problem. You would rather find out what is over there than be safe here.
strengths: Curious past the edge of the map
Finds the wonder in a weird week
Comfortable with nonsense
results.watchOut: Adventure is a fine answer to everything except a direct question.

results.name: REGULAR SHOW
results.tagline: It was supposed to be a normal shift
results.blurb: You had one job. Then the job turned out to involve a haunted keyboard, an interdimensional wrestling match and your boss giving you a lift home. You handle it with the energy of someone who is mostly tired but would never leave a mate behind.
strengths: Turns a boring day into a story
Rock solid when it gets serious
Funny without trying
results.watchOut: Avoiding the work only makes the episode longer. Do the job.
